dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity perimeters with irregular, feathered edge gradients transitioning from a high-contrast outer boundary to a dark-intensity internal core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the interstitial spaces between the larger annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the five most prominent annular structures form a complex, non-linear polygonal arrangement across the mid-dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: A chain-like configuration of interlocking light-intensity rings forming a continuous lattice pattern along the right-lateral margin.
